facts.claim: Hotel Indigo Bali Seminyak Beach hosts weddings; its weddings page is headed 'Luxury Beach Front Weddings' and invites couples to 'celebrate a Bali wedding by Seminyak Beach'.
Hotel Indigo Bali Seminyak Beach describes its wedding settings in its own words as 'beachfront and garden settings' (it uses the words beachfront and beach; ocean appears in venue view labels).

Hotel Indigo Bali Seminyak Beach lists four wedding venues: Secret Garden Pool (up to 80 guests, ocean and sunset view), Tree Bar (up to 80 guests, ocean and sunset view), SugarSand Sunset Terrace (up to 80 guests, sunset view) and Kamaveda and Neighborhood Gallery (up to 80 guests).

Hotel Indigo Bali Seminyak Beach names its ceremony venue choices in packages as the Secret Garden Pool, the Pool Deck and the SugarSand Sunset Terrace, and its FAQ describes a sunset beachfront wedding at the Pool Deck or an intimate garden-style ceremony at the Secret Garden Pool.

Hotel Indigo Bali Seminyak Beach offers Rooms, Suites and private-pool Villas (One Bedroom and Two Bedroom Villas) so guests can stay in the same resort, and suggests larger parties speak to the events or reservations team about room blocks.

Hotel Indigo Bali Seminyak Beach says a dedicated events team (the Gathering & Events team) manages full planning, from venue set-up and catering to wedding-day coordination; its packages include a wedding celebrant described as non-legal.
The Elysian (Seminyak) hosts weddings; its weddings page invites couples to 'celebrate your Bali wedding with a beautiful intimate ceremony at The Elysian'.

The Elysian (Seminyak) says its pool villas are transformed with flowers and touches of Bali for the wedding; its site lists 1 BR and 2 BR Villas. The weddings page does not use the words beachfront, beach, ocean or sea.

The Elysian (Seminyak) offers a Wedding Package and a 'menu' of options covering event planning, flower arrangements, banquet menus, and hair and make-up for the bride and bridal party, with a dedicated team.
